title.en: China’s rules for anthropomorphic AI interaction services take effect
title.zhHans: 中国拟人化 AI 互动服务规则生效

searchSummary.en: China’s interim regulations for anthropomorphic AI services took effect on July 15, 2026, establishing provider obligations for emotional interaction and user protection.
searchSummary.zhHans: 中国《人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法》于 2026 年 7 月 15 日正式施行，确立了情感互动与用户安全防护的合规义务。

summary.en: China’s interim measures for anthropomorphic AI interaction services took effect on July 15, 2026. The rules cover public-facing services that simulate human-like personality, thinking, or communication while providing emotional interaction.
summary.zhHans: 中国拟人化 AI 互动服务管理暂行办法于 2026 年 7 月 15 日生效。该规则覆盖面向公众、模拟人类人格特征、思维方式或交流方式并提供情感互动的服务。

narrative.en: The measures require providers to address self-harm risks, emotional dependence, manipulation, and personal-data handling in covered services. Legal analysis notes that the boundaries of continuous and emotional interaction remain open to interpretation.
narrative.zhHans: 该办法要求服务提供者处理自伤风险、情感依赖、操纵行为和个人数据处理等问题。法律分析指出，持续互动和情感互动的边界仍有待解释。

description.en: The measures establish service-specific national rules for public-facing AI companionship and emotional interaction.
description.zhHans: 该办法为面向公众的 AI 陪伴和情感互动建立了服务类型明确的全国性规则。

description.en: Covered providers face new intervention, safety-design, and data-governance obligations.
description.zhHans: 受规制服务提供者面临新的干预、安全设计和数据治理义务。

text.en: China’s interim measures for anthropomorphic AI interaction services took effect on July 15, 2026.
text.zhHans: 中国拟人化 AI 互动服务管理暂行办法于 2026 年 7 月 15 日生效。

text.en: The measures prohibit inducing emotional dependence or unreasonable decisions and require safeguards for covered services.
text.zhHans: 该办法禁止诱导情感依赖或不合理决策，并要求受规制服务设置相应保障措施。

text.en: The scope of continuous and emotional interaction remains partly open to interpretation.
text.zhHans: 持续互动和情感互动的适用范围仍有部分待解释。
